Fact.Name: Form 8834 line 5
Fact.Description: Form 8834 line 5, the tentative minimum tax an individual copies from Form 6251 line 9: form6251 /amtLine9TentativeMinimumTaxAfterAmtftcFloored, line 7 less the line 8 AMT foreign tax credit, floored at zero. Line 7 less the credit is the section 55(b)(1) amount that section 26(c) makes the tentative minimum tax for this credit, whether or not the filer owes AMT. The floor keeps a negative line 9 (a foreign tax credit above line 7) from raising the line 6 limit above the net regular tax. The reasons for both are on the shared fact.
